lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn6Co2P4 (Mn3CoP2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 121), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for Co, Mn, and P centers: each Co and Mn is surrounded by four P neighbors, while each P has four neighbors (two Co and two Mn), with distances near 2.25–2.30 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co–Mn and P–P tetrahedra, and corner-sharing between Mn–Mn tetrahedra.
